title: leptochilus perakensis
intro: Leptochilus perakensis, commonly known as the Malaysian centipede grass, is a type of plant species in the genus Leptochilus, belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Leptochilus perakensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
